header: Entry pairs never put in one Word Rain round. The key-word rule in deck.js and rounds.js blocks entries that share an English content word; these pairs are true synonyms or near-synonyms that share none (big and large). Seeded 2026-10-26 (plan 2026-10-26-word-rain-game, Step 3) by scanning every pair of non-grammar entries against the synonym groups below and keeping only pairs that exist in the data and were read by hand. Step 4 added the site word lists (src/premium/data/word-lists.json) and with them the pairs from "hypernyms" below: a general word and the words it covers (manu = animal and each animal, manupuna = bird and each bird, lanu = colour and each colour, to'oto'onga = the organs inside the body and each organ), and three near-synonyms in Parts of body. Step 5's judge sweeps the whole deck for more. pair_notes[i] spells out pairs[i].
